messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate after model rollout `model-bundle@v2.1.4` — canary failed (region: us-west-2). Automated canary checks: tokenization mismatch detected in 18% requests. Paging on-call.
Mia (oncall): saw the same in dashboards, spikes started ~2m after deploy. errors mostly `InvalidTokenization` and some `kv-cache` mismatches.
Oliver (infra): can we get the deploy tagged? who rolled it?
Sanjay (ml): rollout was from CI pipeline — model bundle includes weights + tokenizer. Looks like tokenizer version in package is `tokenizer@3.0.0` but serving runtime expects `tokenizer@2.9.1`. That explains parse failures.
Irene (product): any customer-visible impact? Leah, are there incoming tickets?
Leah (support): ACME reported 5xxs on chat feature, just opened a high. Multiple customers reported malformed JSON in responses. I'll paste one: `{"error":"tokenizer mismatch: unknown token \"â\""}`
Mia (oncall): ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag to stop new traffic to v2.1.4 canary 2) rollback to v2.1.3 if flag flip insufficient 3) notify customers. Assigning infra lead for rollback.
Oliver (infra): I will take rollback. running kill-switch for canary routing now (`feature.routing.canary_inference=false`).
Oliver (infra): command: ```
# disable canary routing
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  https://routing.internal/api/flags -d '{"flag":"routing.canary_inference","value":false}'
```
incident-bot: Flag change accepted (routing.canary_inference=false) — propagation started.
Sanjay (ml): while routing flips, confirm we don't have weight mismatch risk on v2.1.3. double-checking checksums.
Oliver (infra): starting rollback to v2.1.3 now with internal deploy CLI.```sh
releases rollback --service inference --to v2.1.3 --note "tokenizer mismatch v2.1.4" --wait
```
deploy-bot: Rollback job started: id=rb-2026-1796543210. Estimated time 2m.
Mia (oncall): paging PD to notify SRE rota and Slack incident channel. @oliver, @sanjay please post status updates every 2 min.
Sanjay (ml): quick sanity: tokenizer mapping diff shows ~120 tokens renamed; validation in test harness failed only for long-tail inputs -> explains 18% failure. We'll prepare a corrected tokenizer build after rollback.
Leah (support): messaging: sent initial "we're investigating" to affected customers (ACME, BetaCo). Asked for error samples.
Oliver (infra): rollback completed. deploy-bot: confirmed state: inference -> v2.1.3 across us-west-2. health checks: 200/200.
deploy-bot: Post-deploy checks: canary traffic drained, all active pods on v2.1.3.
Mia (oncall): monitoring: 5xx rate back to baseline in ~90s, latency stable. Good.
Irene (product): are there any cache/KV concerns after switching versions?
Sanjay (ml): KV cache schema unchanged. but we should invalidate any prefix caches that were saved by v2.1.4 to avoid decode errors on reuse. I'll run a safe prefix cache flush for canary shard ids.
Sanjay (ml): command: `kv-cache flush --prefix model/v2.1.4/canary --confirm` -> done.
Oliver (infra): adding temporary wardens: deployment pipeline PR rule to assert tokenizer version matches runtime expectations before promoting to canary.
Mia (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in 15m; leaving oncall to Oliver. Oliver, please own postmortem notes and any follow-ups.
Oliver (infra): taking over oncall. I'll coordinate postmortem and add remediation tickets: 1) pre-release compatibility check 2) feature-flag kill-switch playbook 3) automated checksum match between model bundle components.
Leah (support): customers updated: ACME accepted temporary mitigation, asked for incident summary and ETA for permanent fix.
Irene (product): please include customer impact table in postmortem (affected endpoints, customers, duration, workaround).
incident-bot: Incident severity set to P1 by automation due to multi-customer impact and rollback.
Mia (oncall): marking thread for postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Oliver (infra): creating postmortem draft now, will link when ready.
deploy-bot: Audit log: user=ci-bot, action=promote, bundle=model-bundle@v2.1.4, sha=abc123def -> promoted to canary at 2026-11-18T03:12:30Z.
Sanjay (ml): follow-up: will produce tokenization compatibility matrix and add it to model onboarding docs.
Leah (support): closing customer-facing ticket after receiving confirmation that service is stable.
incident-bot: Incident closed by Mia (oncall) at 1796544965: service stable, rollback successful.
